description: ASIDIR crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C114 H60 Cl24 N6 Nd4 O25. From the CIF bond table, Nd1 (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd2 (Nd) has 5 O neighbors; Nd3 (Nd) has 9 O neighbors; Nd4 (Nd) has 5 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 3 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 4.058-4.058 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 102.44-102.44°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C114H59Cl24N6O24.5Nd4.
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review.
